rappel_detail.station: The roughly 25-ft rock step on the Northeast Ridge, on the way back from the glacier to the heather chute.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional short single-pitch rappel that many parties make rather than downclimbing the crack; the rest of the descent is downclimbed.

set.rappels: 1 optional short rappel over the 25-ft rock step on the Northeast Ridge; otherwise a downclimb
